task.description:
Acceptance of REQ-057 (card + questionnaire page of the solution picker site) on the running system, in a real Chrome. Acceptance without BA scenarios is allowed here because the design document describes the steps (WF-02 step 8): follow section 18 of docs/design/REQ-057-picker-page.md, steps PR-1 ... PR-11 (the Russian-named steps ПР-1 to ПР-11; ПР-12 is the readers step and is done by BA-ANALYST separately), exactly as written, with the expected results taken from the criteria of REQ-057 in docs/requirements.yaml verbatim; what is wider than a criterion is a remark, not a failure (AP-117). Write the result to docs/uat/REQ-057-RUN.md (in the style of the existing docs/uat/*-RUN.md files, in English) and into the result of your handoff.

Matrix: tenants uchet-pro and svet-marketing; languages ru, kk, en; windows 1470x784, 390x844, 320x568 (Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride); themes light and dark; keyboard-only pass; reload; language change; connection loss (stand stopped and started on the same port); storage unavailable; console check. Take snapshots of: the card, one question, the result stub screen, a connection block, in each of the three windows, in both themes, in the three languages for the main path (use the scratchpad folder given below, not the project); you may take fewer snapshots in cases that are identical in layout, but say so. State the real measured numbers (scrollWidth/clientWidth, target sizes, contrast ratios, focus element) in the run file. Do not guess: every statement has the measured value next to it.

Stand: start your OWN stand on --port 0 with a new home folder inside the scratchpad folder below (PR-1). Do NOT touch the owner's stand on port 4782 or the other server on port 4790. Memory: the computer has 16 GB RAM and little free: run ONE Chrome instance only, one page at a time, close tabs between runs, use the default snapshot scale (deviceScaleFactor 1), and at the end stop Chrome and your stand (PR-11) and check with ps that no Chrome and no stand of yours is left. Chrome is at /Applications/Google Chrome.app (binary inside Contents/MacOS); use headless=new. A failure is recorded with the observed state, snapshot and the exact step; do not fix anything in the project (code or tests); the project files you may change are docs/uat/REQ-057-RUN.md and your handoff. No git checkout/reset/stash/clean, no commits. No machine paths and no other projects' names in the run file or the handoff (paths of snapshots only in your message to ORCH).
Scratchpad folder for output: UAT057 = the folder named uat057 inside the scratchpad directory of this session (ORCH created it; the full path is given in the message that launches you).
